mutation_targets.rationale: removing this fact lets the model build an Operation with opAuthenticated=BoolFalse and opOutcome=Success, which is exactly what the AuthRequired invariant forbids.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuthRequiredViolation { some op: Operation | op.opAuthenticated = BoolFalse and op.opOutcome = Success }

mutation_targets.rationale: without the cross-team-isolation fact, an Operation can succeed against a task in another team, leaking existence and breaking the byte-equivalent 404 invariant.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CrossTeamViolation { some op: Operation, t: Task | op.opTarget = t and t.taskTeam != op.opCallerTeam and op.opOutcome = Success and op.opAuthenticated = BoolTrue and op.opTeamHeader = BoolTrue and op.opKind = GetTask }

mutation_targets.rationale: clearing this fact allows a non-owner non-admin member to successfully PATCH or DELETE a task they do not own — the central FR-009 violation.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_OwnerOrAdminViolation { some op: Operation | op.opOutcome = Success and op.opKind = PatchTask and op.opCallerRole = MemberRole and op.opTarget.taskOwner != op.opCaller }

mutation_targets.rationale: removing this fact lets two distinct operations bind to the same AuditEntry, contradicting the append-only one-source-per-entry invariant.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some disj op1, op2: Operation, a: AuditEntry | op1.opProducedAudit = a and op2.opProducedAudit = a }

mutation_targets.rationale: removing this fact allows a successful CreateTask (or PatchTask/DeleteTask) with no associated AuditEntry, breaking the per-edit-event audit invariant.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditCompletenessViolation { some op: Operation | op.opOutcome = Success and op.opKind = CreateTask and no op.opProducedAudit }

mutation_targets.rationale: removing this fact allows an AuditEntry whose recorded actor differs from the producing operation's caller — misattribution of who did what.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AttributionViolation { some op: Operation, a: AuditEntry | op.opProducedAudit = a and a.auditActor != op.opCaller }
